Corporate Lawyer in Andhra Pradesh

Growing a business means managing legal risk before it becomes a dispute. Dr. Moksha Kalyanram Abhiramula advises startups, MSMEs and established companies in Andhra Pradesh on entity formation, regulatory compliance, contracts, fundraising, M&A and intellectual-property protection, for matters that proceed to the Supreme Court of India or require coordinated representation before the Andhra Pradesh High Court, working alongside local counsel in Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Guntur. Deep experience intersecting law and corporate finance — including structuring SME IPOs and investment due diligence — builds ironclad legal frameworks that let founders grow with confidence.
